products.name: Vitamin C Brightening Face Serum
products.description: A lightweight serum with stabilised vitamin C to even out tone and add a healthy glow. Absorbs quickly under moisturiser.
products.imagePrompt: Amber glass dropper bottle with a white label on a soft beige background, a few citrus slices beside it, bright natural light.

products.name: Niacinamide Oil-Control Moisturiser
products.description: A gel-cream moisturiser that hydrates without heaviness and helps control shine through the day.
products.imagePrompt: White squeeze tube with a minimal teal label, a smooth swatch of gel cream on a pale grey surface.

products.name: Gentle Foaming Face Wash
products.description: A mild foaming wash with neem extract that cleans away oil and pollution without stripping the skin.
products.imagePrompt: Green pump bottle beside fresh neem leaves on a wooden tray, with soft white foam on a wet stone.

products.name: Ultra Light Matte Sunscreen SPF 50
products.description: A fast-absorbing sunscreen with broad-spectrum protection and a non-greasy matte finish, made for Indian sun and sweat.
products.imagePrompt: Slim white tube with orange cap and a sunny yellow backdrop, a bead of sunscreen on a palm.

products.name: Mineral Tinted Sunscreen SPF 30
products.description: A sheer tinted sunscreen that blends with Indian skin tones and evens out the complexion while protecting from UVA and UVB.
products.imagePrompt: Frosted glass jar with a rose gold lid, a small swatch of tinted cream on a marble tile.

products.name: Onion & Bhringraj Hair Oil
products.description: A nourishing blend of cold-pressed sesame oil, onion extract and bhringraj to support strong, shiny hair.
products.imagePrompt: Brown glass bottle with a cream label, a sprig of bhringraj leaves and a small brass bowl of oil.

products.name: Argan & Amla Shampoo
products.description: A sulphate-free shampoo with argan oil and amla to cleanse gently and leave hair soft and manageable.
products.imagePrompt: Frosted white bottle with a sage green label, halved amla fruit and a few argan kernels beside it.

products.name: Rosemary Scalp Serum
products.description: A leave-on scalp serum with rosemary and caffeine to support a healthy scalp and reduce breakage.
products.imagePrompt: Slender dropper bottle with a dark green label, fresh rosemary sprigs tied with twine on a linen cloth.

products.name: Coconut & Honey Body Lotion
products.description: A rich yet quick-absorbing lotion with coconut oil and honey to keep skin soft for up to 24 hours.
products.imagePrompt: Tall pump bottle with a warm cream label, a honeycomb piece and half a coconut on a wooden surface.

products.name: Shea Butter Body Lotion
products.description: A deeply hydrating body lotion with shea butter and vitamin E for skin that feels cushioned all day.
products.imagePrompt: Soft pink tub with a cream label, a scoop of whipped lotion resting on a ceramic dish.

products.name: Kokum Butter Lip Balm
products.description: A nourishing lip balm with kokum butter and beeswax that softens and protects chapped lips.
products.imagePrompt: Round tin with a natural kraft label beside a lip balm stick, a kokum fruit cut in half.

products.name: Rose Tinted Lip Balm
products.description: A sheer rose-tinted balm with jojoba oil for a soft, natural colour and lasting moisture.
products.imagePrompt: Slim rose-gold balm stick with the cap off, a few dried rose petals on a white background.

products.name: Everyday Sample Store Face Mist
products.description: A cooling mist with rose water and aloe to refresh skin at any time of day.
products.imagePrompt: Clear spray bottle with a white cap and a pale pink label, dewy droplets on a pale green leaf.

products.name: Aloe Vera Hydrating Gel
products.description: A pure aloe gel that soothes, cools and hydrates skin, suitable for face and body.
products.imagePrompt: Clear jar of aloe gel with a green lid, a cut aloe leaf beside it on a sunlit windowsill.

products.name: Tea Tree Balancing Toner
products.description: An alcohol-free toner with tea tree and witch hazel to refine pores and calm blemish-prone skin.
products.imagePrompt: Amber dropper bottle with a green label, a tea tree sprig and a cotton pad on a light wood tray.

products.name: Brightening Under-Eye Cream
products.description: A gentle eye cream with caffeine and peptides to help reduce the look of dark circles and puffiness.
products.imagePrompt: Small airless pump tube in matte white, a soft cotton ball on a cream-coloured silk backdrop.

products.name: Hibiscus Strengthening Conditioner
products.description: A conditioner with hibiscus and hydrolysed protein that detangles and reinforces hair from root to tip.
products.imagePrompt: Deep red-pink bottle with a cream label, fresh hibiscus flowers scattered around its base.

products.name: Sample Store Lip Scrub
products.description: A gentle sugar lip scrub with coconut oil that buffs away dry flakes for smoother lips.
products.imagePrompt: Small white jar with a vanilla-coloured label, a spoonful of golden sugar scrub on a wooden spoon.
